title: DPS Increases Patrols Across South Texas for Thanksgiving Travel
excerpt: Texas DPS is stepping up patrols Nov. 25–29 as Thanksgiving travel picks up, urging drivers to buckle up, watch their speed, drive sober, and move over or slow down.
content:
The Texas Department of Public Safety is increasing patrols across South Texas from Nov. 25 through Nov. 29 as Thanksgiving travel picks up, the agency's South Texas Region announced Monday.

Troopers are reminding drivers to buckle up, watch their speed, and drive sober — and to move over or slow down for stopped emergency and roadside vehicles.

Thanksgiving is one of the busiest travel periods of the year, and the extra patrols are aimed at keeping Texas roads safe through the holiday weekend.

Sources: Texas Department of Public Safety — South Texas Region, Nov. 24, 2026.
